q1_issues.issue: The plural "various subgroups" is collapsed into a single witness typed (Member sk_subgroup_1 subgroup), so several subgroups are recorded as one.

"students in various subgroups" is encoded as (GroupOf sk_subgroup_1 student), which asserts the subgroup's members are students and drops the "in" relation between the students and the subgroups; no group symbol for the students themselves exists.

(CardinalityPhrase sk_subgroup_1 "various") counts the members of that one group — the students — whereas "various" quantifies the subgroups, and the possessor at statement 5 inherits the same conflation.
The exemplifying appositive "such as race" is dropped with no atom of any kind.

"various" as a vague plural quantifier — it is neither a proportion word nor one of the listed CardinalityPhrase count phrases
a discourse-initial adversative "But" whose other endpoint lies outside the sentence — the connective rule requires two in-text clauses to relate
